answer: To resist sybils, require each agent to keep a bonded public lantern of signed work: a rolling window of outputs plus a refundable stake. Every epoch, randomly chosen peers take a pulse of that window and check it against the agent's ledger history. A genuine identity carries an echo of prior keys, pacing, and topic commitments; a freshly cloned farm cannot cheaply reproduce that trail. Failed checks slash the stake and freeze voting weight until a new long history is earned.
